experiments.why: A setting string with padded items and empty slots between commas, which must come back trimmed with the empties dropped.
A setting string made only of commas and spaces, which must yield an empty list.

source.quote: Parse a comma-separated setting value into a trimmed, non-empty list.

obligations.statement: Given a comma-separated setting string, parsePiiSwapList returns its comma-separated items with surrounding whitespace trimmed and empty items left out.
